title: The Creator of Heavens, Earth, Darkness and Light

paragraphs.text: Jesus will leave them to Allah, the Wise. On that Day, the truthful will gain from their truth. They will live in gardens forever. Allah is pleased with them. To Allah belong the heavens and the earth.

All praise is for Allah. He made the heavens, the earth, darkness and light. He created you from clay and set your time. He knows your secrets. Yet people turn away from His signs. Allah destroyed many nations before for their sins.
Even a written book from the sky would not convince them. They would call it magic. They ask for an angel to come. Messengers before were mocked too. Travel and see the end of the deniers.
Allah has written mercy upon Himself. He will gather all on the Day of Resurrection. He feeds and is not fed. The Prophet was told to be the first to submit.

hardWords.m: rising from death to new life
